quote: the best way to appreciate art is to try to define it. the same way the best way to live a life is to give your version of meaning.
author: saine metheus

quote: freedom is a pure idea. it occurs spontaneously and without instruction. tyranny requires constant effort. it breaks, it leaks. authority is brittle. oppression is the mask of fear.
author: karis nemik (andor season 2)

quote: the most important decision you make is to be in a good mood.
author: voltaire

quote: the very word secrecy is repugnant in a free and open society; and we are as a people inherently and historically opposed to secret societies, to secret oaths and to secret proceedings. we decided long ago that the dangers of excessive and unwarranted concealment of pertinent facts far outweighed the dangers which are cited to justify it. even today, there is little value in opposing the threat of a closed society by imitating its arbitrary restrictions. even today, there is little value in insuring the survival of our nation if our traditions do not survive with it.
author: jfk

quote: tolerance has reached such a degree where actual intelligent people are forbidden from thinking so as not offend imbeciles
author: found on twitter

quote: simple can be harder than complex. you have to work hard to get your thinking clean to make it simple.
author: steve jobs

quote: your title is just a label. in my experience, respect should be earned, not forced.
author: a random clone trooper from the bad batch season 2

quote: losers change everything but themselves, because they are too lazy to change themselves.
author: saine metheus

quote: a standing person wants to sit; a sitting person wants to sleep; a sleeping person wants to die.
author: tajik national proverb

quote: conflict is the gadfly of thought. it stirs us to observation and memory. it instigates invention. it shocks us out of sheep-like passivity, and sets us at noting and contriving…conflict is a sine qua non of reflection and ingenuity.
author: john dewey

quote: i think a life properly lived is just learn, learn, learn all the time.
author: charlie munger

quote: there is nothing like a sight of an amputated spirit; there is no prosthetic for that.
author: al pacino, scent of a woman, 1992

quote: if you think you are in competition with anyone, for anthing, you are a loser.
author: nassim taleb
